title: Origin story: Loki
description: Loki was a giant by blood, blood-brother to Odin, who lived among the Aesir as their cleverest and least trusted member. His pranks ranged from the amusing — cutting Sif's hair — to the catastrophic: engineering the death of the beloved Baldur, which set the gods on the road to Ragnarok.

title: Ability profile: Loki
description: Ranked abilities: Trickery — rank 100/100; Shapeshifting — rank 99/100; Chaos-sowing — rank 98/100; Escape — rank 97/100; Persuasion — rank 96/100.

title: Power ranking: Loki
description: Powers: Perfect shapeshifting into any living form; A silver tongue that talks its way past gods; Fatherhood of monsters that will end the world.

title: Stamina feats: Loki
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Endured binding under a serpent's venom until Ragnarok; Survived the gods' wrath again and again.

title: Crossover notes: Loki
description: Loki crosses naturally with: mischief, shapeshifting, chaos, cunning.

title: Cultural impact: Loki
description: The archetypal trickster; chaos with a smiling face.
